skills.name: summarize
skills.description: Turns a YouTube video, web article, research paper, or local file (pdf, docx, pptx, ppt, hwp, hwpx, jpg, png, mp4, mov, webm, mp3, m4a, wav) into a LilysAI note. Triggers on "summarize this video", "read these three papers and write it up", "make a note from this PDF", "save this to my Lilys library", whether or not LilysAI is named.
skills.description_zh: 将YouTube视频、网页、论文或本地文档、图片、音视频转为LilysAI笔记并保存到资料库，支持多论文整理与PDF摘要。
